section_summary.extract_value: This introduction reviews obesity and body image issues in middle-aged women, highlights high obesity prevalence in Saudi Arabia, and notes limited research on body appreciation (BA) in middle-aged Saudi women. It states the current study's aims to assess BA, weight status, and weight-loss efforts and to test whether BA mediates the association between BMI-based weight status and weight-loss efforts. No study numbering or sample details are provided in the text.

The second aim was to test the mediation effect of BA on the association between weight status (based on BMI) and WL efforts.'
